_schema.purpose: Incremental-migration control surface for the hybrid DM gate (alert-pipeline-rework B4). Lists the alert sources that have GRADUATED into the gate: their routine (non-critical) alerts default to a non-DM route (`hold`) instead of the global default (`escalate`), so they no longer DM Larry at emit time and are instead promoted later by Pulse (B3), the persistence rule (B5), or the 30-min backstop (B6). Un-migrated sources keep the severity-based default — escalate for warning/critical, digest for info.
_schema.match_rule: Exact match on the alert's `source` against a key in `migrated_sources`. The mapped value is the migrated default route and must be one of larry_alerts.VALID_ROUTES (typically 'hold'); an unrecognized value is ignored (source treated as un-migrated). This default applies ONLY when the emitter passes no explicit route — an explicit caller route still wins, and a `critical` severity still forces 'escalate' (B2), so a migrated source's critical alerts always DM.
_schema.tunable_note: Migration is intentionally incremental (S1): only `outbox-notifier` is migrated initially; P3's weekly retrospective names the rest. Add a source here (value 'hold') to graduate it into the gate without a code change. Remove a source to revert it to the DM-by-default behavior.
